competency_statement_fil: TESDA BHS NC II common competency — Apply basic first aid (strand ng community-based DRRM): sa kathang-isip na kaso, sinusuri ng BHW ang sitwasyon sa pagmamarka ng panganib, pangangailangan at kakayahang kukumpirmahin; tinutulungan ang pamilya na ihanda ang go-bag o e-balde; ipinaaabot lamang ang beripikadong babala at evacuation na impormasyon; ipinapasa ang pangangailangan sa kumpirmadong response team sa aprubadong channel; iniuugnay ang tao sa medical/public health, nutrisyon, WASH at MHPSS na may referral at follow-up; at inaayos ang lahat ng ito sa isang tabletop — sa loob ng tungkulin ng BHW at ng lokal na protocol.
competency_statement_en: TESDA BHS NC II common competency — Apply basic first aid (community-based DRRM strand): in a fictional case, the BHW assesses the situation by marking hazards, support needs and capacities still to be confirmed; helps a family prepare a go-bag or e-balde; relays only verified warning and evacuation information; hands needs to the confirmed response team through the approved channel; links people to medical/public health, nutrition, WASH and MHPSS services with referral and follow-up; and sequences all of this in a tabletop — within the BHW role and local protocol.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Sa fictional na kaso, sa fictional map, ituro ang hazard, pangangailangang suportahan at isang kakayahang kailangang kumpirmahin.
observation_indicators.observable_en: In a fictional case, on the fictional map, identify a hazard, a support need and one capacity needing confirmation.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Itinuturing na kumpirmadong silungan ang paaralan o minamarkahan ang totoong sambahayan sa mapa.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Treats the school as a confirmed shelter or marks a real household on the map.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Namamarkahan ang panganib, pangangailangan at kakayahan, nasasabi kung sino ang magpapatunay sa kakayahan, at walang totoong lokasyon, nang walang paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Marks a hazard, a support need and a capacity, names who will verify the capacity, and shows no real location, without prompts.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Namamarkahan ang tatlong layer ngunit kailangan ng paalala sa magpapatunay o sa pag-alis ng lokasyon ng sambahayan.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Marks the three layers but needs a prompt to name who will verify or to leave out the household's location.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Itinuturing na kumpirmadong silungan ang paaralan o minamarkahan ang totoong sambahayan sa mapa.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Treats the school as a confirmed shelter or marks a real household on the map.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Sa fictional na kaso, gamit ang mock advisory, sabihin ang source/oras, kumpirmadong aksiyon at contact na kukumpirmahin.
observation_indicators.observable_en: In a fictional case, using a mock advisory, state source/time, confirmed action and contact to verify.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Ipinapasa bilang totoo ang lumang directory, di-kumpirmadong ruta o sariling evacuation order.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Relays the old directory, an unconfirmed route or a self-made evacuation order as fact.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Nasasabi ang source at oras ng advisory, inihihiwalay ang kumpirmado sa hinihintay pa, at nasasabi ang contact na kukumpirmahin, nang walang paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: States the advisory source and time, keeps confirmed apart from pending, and names the contact to verify, without prompts.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Nasasabi ang kumpirmadong aksiyon ngunit kailangan ng paalala sa source at oras o sa contact na kukumpirmahin.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Gives the confirmed action but needs a prompt to state the source and time or the contact to verify.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Ipinapasa bilang totoo ang lumang directory, di-kumpirmadong ruta o sariling evacuation order.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Relays the old directory, an unconfirmed route or a self-made evacuation order as fact.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Sa fictional na kaso, pumili ng gamit para sa fictional pamilya, ipaliwanag ang dahilan at petsa ng susunod na pag-check.
observation_indicators.observable_en: In a fictional case, select items for the fictional family, explain why, and set a date to recheck.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Kinokopya ang listahan nang walang pangangailangan ng sanggol o gamot, o nag-aalok na magbigay ng gamot.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Copies a list without the infant's or medicine needs, or offers to supply medicine.

levels.kaya_na_fil: May dahilan sa bawat piniling gamit, itinatanong ang access sa regular na gamot at nagtatakda ng petsa ng pag-check, nang walang paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Gives a reason for each chosen item, asks about access to regular medicine and sets a recheck date, without prompts.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Angkop ang piniling gamit ngunit kailangan ng paalala sa dahilan, sa access sa gamot o sa petsa ng pag-check.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Chooses suitable items but needs a prompt to give reasons, ask about medicine access or set a recheck date.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Kinokopya ang listahan nang walang pangangailangan ng sanggol o gamot, o nag-aalok na magbigay ng gamot.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Copies a list without the infant's or medicine needs, or offers to supply medicine.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Sa fictional na kaso, sa mock team change, tukuyin ang dapat kumpirmahin at magbigay ng maikling handover nang walang personal na detalye.
observation_indicators.observable_en: In a fictional case, in a mock team change, identify what to confirm and give a short handover without personal details.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Umaasa sa lumang roster, o may pangalan o detalye ng kalusugan sa handover.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Relies on the old roster, or includes names or health details in the handover.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Kinukumpirma ang kasalukuyang team, lead at channel, saka nagbibigay ng maikling handover na may oras at walang pangalan o diagnosis, nang walang paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Confirms the current team, lead and channel, then gives a short handover with the time and no name or diagnosis, without prompts.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Nakapagbibigay ng handover ngunit kailangan ng paalala na kumpirmahin muna ang lead o itala ang oras.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Gives the handover but needs a prompt to confirm the current lead first or to record the time.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Umaasa sa lumang roster, o may pangalan o detalye ng kalusugan sa handover.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Relies on the old roster, or includes names or health details in the handover.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Sa fictional na kaso, itugma ang apat na fictional pangangailangan sa tamang serbisyo at sabihin ang referral at follow-up.
observation_indicators.observable_en: In a fictional case, match four fictional needs to the appropriate service and state referral and follow-up.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Nagrereseta, nagtatakda ng ration, nagdedeklarang ligtas ang tubig, nagbibigay ng therapy o pinipilit ang salaysay ng nababagabag.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Prescribes, sets rations, declares water safe, gives therapy or demands the distressed person's story.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Naitutugma ang apat na pangangailangan sa tamang domain, nasasabi ang puwang ng focal person at kung paano babalik ang feedback, nang walang paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Matches all four needs to the right domain, names the focal person slot and says how feedback returns, without prompts.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Naitutugma ang domain ngunit kailangan ng paalala sa follow-up o sa pagsuri muna ng kaligtasan ng nababagabag.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Matches the domains but needs a prompt for the follow-up or for checking the distressed person's safety first.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Nagrereseta, nagtatakda ng ration, nagdedeklarang ligtas ang tubig, nagbibigay ng therapy o pinipilit ang salaysay ng nababagabag.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Prescribes, sets rations, declares water safe, gives therapy or demands the distressed person's story.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Sa fictional na kaso, sa 10 minutong tabletop, ayusin ang prayoridad, handover, continuity, follow-up at suporta sa responder.
observation_indicators.observable_en: In a fictional case, in a 10-minute tabletop, sequence priorities, handover, continuity, follow-up and responder support.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Gumagamit ng di-kumpirmadong contact, walang follow-up o iniiwang walang kapalit ang pagod na volunteer.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Uses unconfirmed contacts, skips follow-up or leaves the exhausted volunteer without relief.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Inuuna ang ligtas na paglikas, may unang ligtas na aksiyon, kumpirmadong lead at follow-up ang bawat isyu, at may kapalit ang volunteer, nang walang paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Puts safe evacuation first, gives each issue a first safe action, confirmed lead and follow-up, and arranges relief for the volunteer, without prompts.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Naaayos ang mga isyu ngunit kailangan ng paalala sa pagtatala ng pagtanggap, follow-up o kapalit ng volunteer.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Orders the issues but needs a prompt to record acknowledgement, set follow-up or relieve the volunteer.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Gumagamit ng di-kumpirmadong contact, walang follow-up o iniiwang walang kapalit ang pagod na volunteer.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Uses unconfirmed contacts, skips follow-up or leaves the exhausted volunteer without relief.
